name: kelpie
description: Configurable funnel runtime with versioning, experiments, and session analytics

scripts.development: npm run build:packages && npm run database:generate && node scripts/development.mjs
scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace=@kelpie/contracts && npm run build --workspace=@kelpie/funnel-runtime
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run database:generate && npm run build --workspace=@kelpie/backend && npm run build --workspace=@kelpie/frontend && npm run build --workspace=@kelpie/quiz
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run database:generate && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.traffic:profile: npm run build:packages && npm run database:generate && tsx --tsconfig applications/backend/tsconfig.json applications/backend/tests/benchmarks/traffic/run-traffic.ts
scripts.traffic:profile:bun: npm run build:packages && npm run database:generate && node scripts/traffic-profile-build.mjs && bun applications/backend/distribution-traffic/tests/benchmarks/traffic/run-traffic.js
scripts.verify: npm run configurations:verify && npm run tests:layout && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build && npm run database:validate
scripts.configurations:import: npm run build:packages && npm run database:generate && npm run configurations:import --workspace=@kelpie/backend --
scripts.administration:provision: npm run build:packages && npm run database:generate && npm run administration:provision --workspace=@kelpie/backend
scripts.development:bun: npm run build:packages && npm run database:generate && bun scripts/development.mjs
scripts.verify:bun: npm run verify && npm run test:bun
scripts.database:backup: npm run build:packages && npm run database:generate && npm run database:backup --workspace=@kelpie/backend --
scripts.database:restore: npm run build:packages && npm run database:generate && npm run database:restore --workspace=@kelpie/backend --
scripts.storage:compact: npm run build:packages && npm run database:generate && npm run storage:compact --workspace=@kelpie/backend --
